verses.text: A man from Levi’s family married a woman from Levi’s family. 👨‍👩‍👦
She became pregnant and had a son. She saw he was a fine child, so she kept him hidden for three months. 👶
When she couldn’t hide him anymore, she made a papyrus basket, sealed it with tar and pitch, placed the baby inside, and set it among the reeds by the riverbank. 🧺
His sister stood a little way off, watching to see what would happen to him. 👀
Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe in the river while her attendants walked along the bank. She spotted the basket among the reeds and sent her servant to get it. 🌊
She opened it and saw the baby crying. She felt compassion for him and said, ‘This must be one of the Hebrew children.’ 🥺
The baby’s sister asked Pharaoh’s daughter, ‘Should I find a Hebrew woman to nurse the baby for you?’ 💬
Pharaoh’s daughter said, ‘Go.’ So the young woman went and called the baby’s mother. 🏃
Pharaoh’s daughter told her, ‘Take this baby and nurse him for me. I’ll pay you.’ So the woman took her child and nursed him. 🤱
The child grew up, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, who adopted him as her son. She named him Moses, saying, ‘I pulled him out of the water.’ 💧
When Moses had grown up, he went out to where his people were working and saw their heavy labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew—one of his own people. 👀
Moses looked around. Seeing no one, he killed the Egyptian and buried him in the sand. ⚠️
The next day he went out again and saw two Hebrew men fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, ‘Why are you hitting your fellow Hebrew?’ 🗣️
The man answered, ‘Who made you our boss and judge? Are you going to kill me like you killed the Egyptian?’ Moses became afraid and thought, ‘People know what I did.’ 😨
When Pharaoh heard about it, he tried to kill Moses. But Moses ran from Pharaoh and settled in Midian, where he sat down by a well. 🏃
The priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came to draw water and fill the troughs for their father’s flock. 🐑
Some shepherds came and drove them away, but Moses stood up for them and watered their flock. 💪
When they got back to their father Reuel, he asked, ‘How did you get back so early today?’ 🏠
They said, ‘An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds. He even drew water for us and watered the flock.’ 💧
He asked his daughters, ‘Where is he? Why did you leave him there? Go invite him in so he can eat.’ 🍽️
Moses agreed to stay with the man, who gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses as a wife. 💍
She had a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, ‘I’ve been a foreigner in a foreign land.’ 👶
After a long time, Egypt’s king died. The Israelites groaned under their slavery and cried out for help; their cry rose up to God. 😢
God heard their groaning and remembered his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. 🙏
God saw the Israelites and understood what they were going through. 💔
